text: In IIR-filter language, the echo state property corresponds to which condition?
choices: The filter's zeros all lie outside the unit circle
The feedforward taps h_k sum to exactly 1
All of the reservoir's 'poles' lie inside the unit circle (rho(W_rec) < 1 for linear reservoirs)
At least one pole lies exactly on the unit circle
explanation: The reading equates the ESP with placing the reservoir's poles inside the unit circle, i.e. rho(W_rec) < 1 for linear reservoirs, making the ESN a stable nonlinear IIR filter. Poles on or outside the circle give marginal or unstable behavior, and the tap-sum and zeros conditions are unrelated to the ESP.
